alt: A short version of the query for the nine-node tree. It reads the two query nodes, the depth of every node and the ancestor table, climbs the deeper node by the depth difference using the set bits, then tries the levels from highest to lowest, jumping both nodes only where their targets differ, and prints the lowest common ancestor.
